<div class='pages'>
	<div class='heading'>
	<h1>Chat GPT Trial Classes <a name='Nirrum's Encyclopedia of Varomar 2:Tajik:Playing this world:5e Conversion:Chat GPT Trial Classes'></a></h1>
	</div>

	<div class='content'>
	<p>
Created Tuesday 13 May 2025
</p>

<br>

<p>
<a href="./Chat_GPT_Trial_Classes/Class_Breakdown.html" title="+Class_Breakdown" class="page">+Class_Breakdown</a>
</p>

<p>
<a href="./Chat_GPT_Trial_Classes/csv.html" title="+csv" class="page">+csv</a>
</p>

<p>
🎯 Design Goals
</p>

<br>
<br>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Fully replicate all 5e class progressions.
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Be modular and customizable for multiclassing, homebrew, or unique builds.
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Point values should balance progression across all classes.
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Easy to use with a table or list of features per class level.
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Allow subclass features and spellcasting progression.
</div>
</p>

<p>
⚙️ System Overview<br>
<ol type="1" start="1">
<li>Point Budget Per Level</li>
</ol>
</p>

<p>
Players gain a pool of Feature Points (FP) each level. They spend these to "buy" class features.<br>
Level	Total FP	FP Gained This Level<br>
1	3	3<br>
2	6	3<br>
3	10	4<br>
4	14	4<br>
5	19	5<br>
6	24	5<br>
7	30	6<br>
8	36	6<br>
9	43	7<br>
10	50	7<br>
11	58	8<br>
12	66	8<br>
13	75	9<br>
14	84	9<br>
15	94	10<br>
16	104	10<br>
17	115	11<br>
18	126	11<br>
19	138	12<br>
20	150	12<br>
🧩 Feature Point Costs
</p>

<p>
Each feature is broken down into types with average power levels across classes. These point values reflect general utility, power, and frequency of use.
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
✅ Use these values to replicate any class progression by summing the features gained at each level.
</div>
</p>

<p>
Core Features<br>
Feature Type	FP Cost<br>
Hit Die (d6)	1<br>
Hit Die (d8)	2<br>
Hit Die (d10)	3<br>
Hit Die (d12)	4<br>
Proficiencies (basic: armor, weapons)	1–3<br>
Saving Throw Proficiency (per save)	2<br>
Skill Proficiency (per skill)	1
</p>

<p>
Combat Features<br>
Feature	FP Cost<br>
Fighting Style	4<br>
Extra Attack (1)	8<br>
Extra Attack (2) (Fighter only)	10<br>
Action Surge (1/rest)	8<br>
Rage (2x/day, scales)	6<br>
Sneak Attack (per 1d6)	1<br>
Divine Smite (per level tier)	3–5<br>
Wild Shape (2 uses, CR 1/4)	6<br>
War Magic (Eldritch Knight / Bladesinger)	4–6<br>
Spellcasting<br>
Spellcasting Feature	FP Cost<br>
Spellcasting (Full Caster, level 1)	6<br>
Spellcasting (Half Caster, level 1)	4<br>
Spellcasting (Third Caster, level 1)	3<br>
Cantrips Known (per cantrip)	1<br>
Spell Known (per spell)	1<br>
Spell Slot Progression (per level tier)	Varies*
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
*Spell slot progression is more complex. Full casters get ~4 FP per level just from spell slot growth, scaling up to ~10 FP by level 20.
</div>
</p>

<p>
Subclasses<br>
Subclass Feature Tier	FP Cost<br>
Subclass Feature (3rd level)	6<br>
Subclass Feature (6th level)	5<br>
Subclass Feature (10th level)	5<br>
Subclass Feature (14th/18th level)	6
</p>

<p>
Utility Features<br>
Feature Type	FP Cost<br>
Expertise (per skill)	2<br>
Jack of All Trades	3<br>
Bardic Inspiration (d6, 1/rest)	4<br>
Channel Divinity (1/rest)	5<br>
Evasion, Uncanny Dodge	5<br>
Indomitable, Relentless Endurance	4<br>
Aura (10 ft)	5<br>
Lay on Hands (5x level pool)	4<br>
Sorcery Points (scales)	6<br>
Metamagic (per option)	2<br>
Invocations (per invocation)	3<br>
Pact Magic (Warlock style)	6<br>
Arcane Recovery, Natural Recovery	2
</p>

<p>
Capstones &amp; High-Level Features<br>
High-Level Feature	FP Cost<br>
20th-level capstone (e.g., Archdruid, Eldritch Master)	10–12<br>
Signature Spell / Foresight-like effect	8–10
</p>
